svg.title: Nearly identical fits hide four different patterns
svg.desc: Four scatterplots with similar regression summaries show a linear cloud, curvature, a response outlier, and a high-leverage point.

g.text: an outlier and a high-leverage point.
Anscombe (1973), Figs. 1–4 and data table. Each panel contains 11 observations.
